method: Translated printed rules text into the repository's existing ability factories, selectors, costs and timing events. Reprints reuse their existing scripts. Comparison scripts below are ranked by shared rules API calls as review pointers; they do not imply identical card rules or full validation.

loading.instructions: Normal CardsDB initialization and SceneLoader.NewScene use these packs directly. Select Jessica Jones or Luke Cage from the normal hero or starter-deck menu. The test harness also uses the normal catalog and decks.
loading.deck_note: Each starter has 15 deck cards from the hero set plus 25 player cards; Jessica also starts with permanent Alias Investigations. The experimental directory retains the original review snapshots, not a separate runtime catalog.

validation.run: .venv-release\Scripts\python.exe -X utf8 -m unittest unit_test.test_jj_luke_first_pass unit_test.test_jj_engine_support unit_test.test_jj_hero_gameplay unit_test.test_luke_hero_gameplay unit_test.test_jj_luke_nemesis_gameplay unit_test.test_jj_luke_multiplayer_gameplay unit_test.test_form_change_lifecycle unit_test.test_overkill_damage_modifiers unit_test.test_bulletproof_belle_boost_damage unit_test.test_resource_cost_reduction unit_test.test_kingpin_side_scheme_reveals unit_test.test_fear_no_evil_player_cards unit_test.test_fear_no_evil_modular_sets unit_test.test_wonder_man_jarvis unit_test.test_thwart_target_restrictions unit_test.test_attached_identity_restrictions unit_test.test_attached_health_flip unit_test.test_optional_choice_confirmation unit_test.test_end_phase_hand_limit unit_test.test_v18_timing_integration unit_test.test_purple_man_obligation_readiness unit_test.test_sense_enemy_defeat unit_test.test_attack_defender_player unit_test.test_victory_defeat unit_test.test_jj_player_cards_gameplay unit_test.test_luke_player_cards_gameplay unit_test.test_jj_luke_shared_player_gameplay -q
validation.coverage: All 81 pack faces have targeted gameplay coverage: the previous 39 hero/obligation/nemesis faces plus all 42 player-card faces. 76 new player gameplay tests, 127 previous pack tests and 173 existing regression tests pass after correcting one old test's explicit defense choice.
validation.limits: Headless solo/two-player gameplay; manual browser gameplay and exhaustive campaign/multi-villain combinations are outside this validation.

cards.name: Jessica Jones
cards.review_note: Basic-power responses add evidence only to the initiating player's Alias Investigations.

cards.name: Jessica Jones
cards.review_note: Setup creates Alias Investigations; Incognito Mode prevents returning to alter-ego for the phase.

cards.name: Alias Investigations
cards.review_note: Evidence is optional to spend after the counter placement; test multiplayer and multi-villain stage-defeat edge cases before release.

cards.name: Piecing It All Together
cards.review_note: The metadata opts this scheme out of the player side-scheme limit.

cards.name: 4K Digital Camcorder
cards.review_note: Use an explicit Minion/ELITE/affordability selector and pay evidence as a cost before discarding the minion.

cards.name: Circumstantial Evidence
cards.review_note: Respond to the generic enemy-defeated event; discard still does not count as defeat.

cards.name: Stakeout
cards.review_note: The +2 thwart and evidence reward are tied to the same thwart occurrence. Covered by an actual basic-thwart test.

cards.name: Strategy Session
cards.review_note: Two separately gated Play abilities provide alter-ego and hero modes, following existing multi-mode events.

cards.name: Run Them to Ground
cards.review_note: Implemented and tested: skip the entire next villain phase, including its start/end events; immediately deal one facedown encounter card to each player; block villain damage until the next villain phase actually begins. End-of-round effects still resolve. Multiple requests to skip the same next phase do not queue extra skips.

cards.name: Grapnel Launcher
cards.review_note: Implemented and tested: copy the hero's native basic-thwart ability, waive only its ordinary exhaustion cost, retain additional costs and normal basic-power responses, apply +1 THW for that thwart, and ignore patrol/crisis only for that ability. Confusion replaces the thwart normally. Ready/exhausted state, costs and modifiers are checked for cleanup.

cards.name: Entrapment
cards.review_note: Changing to hero form is paid before discarding the upgrade and dealing damage. Both successful and blocked form-change costs are tested.

cards.name: Hellcat
cards.review_note: Review the delayed discard if Hellcat leaves and re-enters play during the same phase.

cards.name: Joys of Life
cards.review_note: Alliance uses the existing shared-payment machinery; multiplayer exhaustion choices need playtesting.

cards.name: Defend Our City
cards.review_note: Prerequisite checks the identity's current DEFENDER trait. Review the Team-Up discount across multiple players and out-of-play source cleanup.

cards.name: Purple Man
cards.review_note: Dynamic printed-X values use other characters' current ATK, SCH and THW. Test multiple interacting variable-stat minions before release.

cards.name: Suggestion ([energy])
cards.review_note: Continue applying the remaining finder restrictions after the playability check. Apply 2 threat if no selected card was played, including an unavailable payment.

cards.name: Suggestion ([mental])
cards.review_note: Continue applying the remaining finder restrictions after the playability check. Apply 2 threat if no selected card was played, including an unavailable payment.

cards.name: Suggestion ([physical])
cards.review_note: Continue applying the remaining finder restrictions after the playability check. Apply 2 threat if no selected card was played, including an unavailable payment.

cards.name: Mitigated Threat
cards.review_note: Implemented and tested: attach to a card and suppress all acceleration, amplify, crisis and hazard icons, including subsequently gained icons. Suppression stacks and restores correctly on discard, blanking or reattachment. At round end every player may pay one resource from their own resources; any declined payment discards the upgrade after every player has been asked. Upkeep still resolves after a skipped villain phase.

cards.name: Luke Cage
cards.review_note: Multiple Tough cards survive form changes. Each Tough discarded in hero form causes separate unpreventable damage; Tough does not prevent or get removed by that damage.

cards.name: Luke Cage
cards.review_note: Uses the same unlimited-Tough and lost-piercing mechanics as the hero face; Burstein Process search is once per phase.

cards.name: "Sweet Christmas!"
cards.review_note: Tough reduces the cost. Damage targets villains and minions engaged with this player; review singular-villain selection in multi-villain scenarios.

cards.name: Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
cards.review_note: Only attacks by the attached enemy gain damage and overkill; unrelated damage abilities do not gain the attack bonus.

cards.name: Metal Bracer
cards.review_note: Damage reduction occurs in the would-deal window before Tough; unpreventable damage is excluded.

cards.name: Iron Fist
cards.review_note: Prevention currently runs in the would-take-damage window while defending. Review changes to Iron Fist's ATK between defense declaration and damage.

cards.name: Take a Stand
cards.review_note: Snapshots controlled allies at resolution. The bonus survives villain-phase end and expires at the end of the next player phase.

cards.name: Energy
cards.implementation: Printed resource icons and deck limit in cards.json; no bespoke ability needed.

cards.name: Genius
cards.implementation: Printed resource icons and deck limit in cards.json; no bespoke ability needed.

cards.name: Strength
cards.implementation: Printed resource icons and deck limit in cards.json; no bespoke ability needed.

cards.name: Internal Injury
cards.review_note: Uses the new unpreventable property, rather than only bypassing Tough.

cards.name: Cottonmouth
cards.review_note: The initial attack plus two forced attacks resolve separately; the response triggers only once per phase.

cards.name: Venomous Whispers
cards.review_note: Read the activation recipient from the boost message.

cards.name: Augmented Jaws
cards.review_note: All Tough cards are discarded before the attached enemy's attack; each discarded card can trigger Luke's forced response.

cards.name: Asp
cards.review_note: Read the activation recipient from the boost message.

cards.name: Sidewinder
cards.review_note: A discarded encounter card with a boost ability moves Sidewinder into the attacking player's dealt encounter cards.
